meta.generated_code_review: queries.rs differs only in H05 SF1/SF10 load_setup (gpu_compress::{Source::load_manifest, Catalog::compress} -> crate::loader::{load_source, compress_catalog}) after normalizing build paths and path-derived kernel-module hashes; plans.json equal except generation_seconds; doop/datalog/datalog-runtime sources unchanged between revisions

protocol.warmup: one untimed process per revision per workload
protocol.metric_tpch: per-process median of five total_ms (validated: first measured sample full exact, later bench-check sampled)
protocol.metric_doop: doop-gpu xalan GPU_DATALOG_PHASES fixpoint seconds; every process compares all 26 complete output tuple sets against doop-mini
protocol.locks: GPU-only discovery; confirmation takes GPU, timing-gate, then exclusive timing lock per sample
protocol.discard: foreign GPU tenant or 1-minute load above 8 before or after a sample (none discarded)
protocol.bootstrap: per item exhaustive 5^5 paired percentile 95%; TPC-H suite geomean resampled 20000 times, seed 20261106
